name.en-US: On the Motion of the Heart

description.en-US: A late short consultation on the natural philosophy of the human heart's motion, addressed to Master Philip of Castro Coeli.
description.la: Responsum breve serotinum de philosophia naturali motus cordis humani, ad magistrum Philippum de Castro Coeli compositum.
description.pt-BR: Breve resposta tardia sobre a filosofia natural do movimento do coração humano, dirigida a Mestre Filipe de Castro Caeli.

sources.description: English translation by Vincent R. Larkin, revised by the Aquinas Institute. Mirrored from aquinas.cc.
Latin text from the Leonine / Marietti editions (public domain), mirrored from aquinas.cc.
